title: CARE-AD: a multi-agent large language model framework for Alzheimer's disease prediction using longitudinal clinical notes
details: R Li, X Wang, D Berlowitz, J Mez, H Lin, H Yu - npj Digital Medicine, 2025
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities across diverse domains, yet their application to complex clinical prediction tasks remains limited. In this study, we present CARE-AD (Collaborative Analysis and Risk Evaluation for …
